population_disposition.decision_record: Operator instruction in session_01MF4NmhzorUcjervkD9U5ju, verbatim: "HUH. ONLY 3 UJUST FIX MANUAL" -- given after being shown that exactly 3 placements blocked the build and that 7413 instances were otherwise emitted with 0 errors.
population_disposition.reason: MEASURED. A street light (pole_streetlight, ann-1789503518977-88b8c8) triangulated at E 379775.37 N 3938501.87, which falls 0.71 m INSIDE the outline of building way/225369224, and 3.00 m from road 264753665. The observation's own sigma is 0.250 m, so the nearest clear position is 2.8x its uncertainty away and no lawful move exists. WHY NEITHER SIDE IS OBVIOUSLY WRONG. way/225369224 is an untouched OSM footprint: footprint_source 'osm', and its canonical ring is byte-identical to the ingest ring, so the PLATEAU rewrite did not cause this. A hand-traced building outline carries its own tracing error, and this pipeline models observation uncertainty but declares no footprint uncertainty anywhere. The 0.71 m discrepancy is comfortably inside normal OSM outline error and well outside the observation's sigma, so the contradiction most likely lies in the footprint, which this lane has no authority to move. WHAT IS GIVEN UP. One street light is not built. The sighting remains on the record and this decision asserts no absence.
